senses.gloss: (corr. אַפּוֹ׳) f. (ἀποκοτταβίζειν) orig. playing at cottabus, or squirting wine into a bowl; trnsf. (S.) the gourmand’s practice of taking an emetic before meal; to vomit.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:6">Tosef. ib. XVI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 17:22">XVII</cite>), 22, Var. ed. Zuck. <he>אפקטויזין</he>.

<cite ref="Sukkah 40b:2">Succ. 40ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 102a:7">B. Kam. 102ᵃ</cite>; Sifra B’har ch. I, end <he>אפיקטפיזים</he> (corr. acc.). [A noun ἀποκοττάβισις to which our w. would correspond, is not in the vocabulary.]
